subject: planner: Enable the non-prepared plan cache for queries with bindings. (#61048)
summary: Removes the `!useBinding` guard so non-prepared plan cache can be used even when SQL bindings match. Adds `skipNonPreparedCache` for `resource_group` and `SET_VAR` statement hints to avoid running their side-effecting handling twice. Updates unit/integration tests to assert `@@last_plan_from_binding` and `@@last_plan_from_cache` behavior with bindings.
